Build an agent that researches Norwegian companies from permitted public sources. Given a company number, it should return useful facts with source links and dates, keep facts attached to the right company, and detect later changes. Starter kit The Builderr challenge page includes a runnable Python starter and a saved example. It is the fastest way to see the expected input, output, and source-evidence format before you build. What to submit • At least 1,000 company profiles • Repository link and exact commit hash • One command to run the agent • Model/API details and expected run costs How we test and score Each completed test uses a new randomly selected batch of 100 companies. Across the competition, we keep a cumulative locked set of checked facts, so daily tests do not reduce the task to one familiar company list. Find useful information (35 points), match it correctly with evidence (30), update correctly (20), give useful explanations (10), and make it easy to use (5). Coverage is compared with a checked collection built from submissions and Builderr crawlers. To qualify: at least 65/100 overall, 21/35 coverage, and all published accuracy, evidence, and execution requirements. A material wrong-company publication or fabricated financial value fails the entry. Qualified agents are ranked by their average score across completed daily tests. Daily limits: 45 minutes, 2,000 outbound requests, and $10 in declared external API costs. Development and API usage can incur costs. Rewards $2,000 main cash prizes: $1,200 / $500 / $300. Separate $500 JBOX bonus: $250 / $150 / $100 for qualifying agents built with JBOX. Awards require qualification; participation does not guarantee a prize or job. How to enter Register and share your project link on Unstop by 17 October, 11:59 PM IST

raw.details:
Overview

 

Start on Builderr: https://builderr.ai/challenges/signalpost?utm_source=unstop&utm_medium=challenge_listing&utm_campaign=signalpost_2026

 

Registering on Unstop does not submit an entry.

 

Build an agent that researches Norwegian companies from permitted public sources. Given a company number, it should return useful facts with source links and dates, keep facts attached to the right company, and detect later changes.

 

Starter kit

 

The Builderr challenge page includes a runnable Python starter and a saved example. It is the fastest way to see the expected input, output, and source-evidence format before you build.

 

What to submit

 

• At least 1,000 company profiles

• Repository link and exact commit hash

• One command to run the agent

• Model/API details and expected run costs

 

How we test and score

 

Each completed test uses a new randomly selected batch of 100 companies. Across the competition, we keep a cumulative locked set of checked facts, so daily tests do not reduce the task to one familiar company list.

 

Find useful information (35 points), match it correctly with evidence (30), update correctly (20), give useful explanations (10), and make it easy to use (5). Coverage is compared with a checked collection built from submissions and Builderr crawlers.

 

To qualify: at least 65/100 overall, 21/35 coverage, and all published accuracy, evidence, and execution requirements. A material wrong-company publication or fabricated financial value fails the entry. Qualified agents are ranked by their average score across completed daily tests.

 

Daily limits: 45 minutes, 2,000 outbound requests, and $10 in declared external API costs. Development and API usage can incur costs.

 

Rewards

 

$2,000 main cash prizes: $1,200 / $500 / $300. Separate $500 JBOX bonus: $250 / $150 / $100 for qualifying agents built with JBOX. Awards require qualification; participation does not guarantee a prize or job.

 

How to enter

 

Register and share your project link on Unstop by 17 October, 11:59 PM IST. Send the complete Signalpost entry to submit@builderr.ai. Builderr accepts code revisions until 18 October and runs the competition through 21 October.
